purpose: Initial forecast comparison and forward instrumentation; insufficient history for profitability promotion
forward_start: actual model artifact publication time, never backdated
history_window_choice: Starts after the already observed August 18 index repair; later dates were chosen before inspecting index forecast errors
historical_lag_status: UNVERIFIED sensitivity assumption, not proof of public availability; historical P&L prohibited
gaussian_fit: training residual mean and sample standard deviation, minimum standard deviation 0.05 F
empirical_fit: training residual empirical distribution, Jeffreys-smoothed threshold probability
thresholds: actual listed market strikes only; score all available strikes, average within event before statistical comparison
primary_validation_score: event-averaged Brier score against official index labels and market benchmark where contemporaneous quotes exist
independent_sampling_unit: UTC day, all hourly events on that day kept together
model_selection: no model promoted on this five-day validation; all models retained as labeled exploratory baselines
historical_prices: minute-end bid/ask candles for prediction scores only; exclude absent/crossed/one-sided quotes; no invented fills
forward_orders: zero recommended real-money size; before-outcome probabilities logged with evidence limitations
